summary: Allocation helper: returns 0 immediately when either argument is null; otherwise allocates a2 bytes via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc (0x0058A935) and, if the allocation returns null, raises an out-of-memory condition through GuardedCallWithLongjmp (0x00511869) with the global "Out of Memory" string (0x005AFA90). Returns the allocated pointer.

operations.description: Guard on inputs: if either a1 or a2 is null, return 0 without allocating.
v2 = MallocWrapperForNhMalloc(a2) allocates a2 bytes through the NH malloc wrapper.
Guard on allocation result: when v2 is null, enter the out-of-memory path.
GuardedCallWithLongjmp(a1, "Out of Memory") triggers the guarded failure path using the global message string aOutOfMemory (0x005AFA90) and the a1 context.
Return v2, the allocated pointer (null only when the early input guard fired).
